summary: Saving Data Processing Rules now runs on ArcRho Server and shows its progress in a window, like Import Data.
details: The check of every generated dataset that follows a save runs next to the data instead of over the network drive, so a save that took minutes from a workstation now takes seconds.
A progress window opens when you press Apply and save, follows each step, and closes when the rules are saved.
Without a running ArcRho Engine the save still works the old way.
